title: CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Key Imports
content:
# CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Key Imports

Ek important update hai. Government ne various goods jaise gold, silver, edible oils, aur brass scrap ke customs tariff values revise kiye hain. Yeh change importers aur relevant industries ke liye significant hai.

*   **Notification Reference:** Yeh revision Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne Notification No. 68/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated July 31, 2026, ke through announce kiya hai.
*   **Effective Date:** Naye tariff values August 1, 2026, se लागू ho gaye hain.
*   **Amended Notification:** Is notification ne Notification No. 36/2001-Customs (N.T.) ko amend kiya hai, jo Customs Act, 1962 ke section 14(2) ke under tariff values fix karta hai.
*   **Key Revisions:**
    *   **Gold:** Tariff value ab US$ 1323 per 10 grams set kiya gaya hai.
    *   **Silver:** Tariff value US$ 1875 per kilogram ho gaya hai.
    *   **Edible Oils:** Crude Palm Oil (US$ 1211/MT), RBD Palm Oil (US$ 1212/MT), Crude Palmolein (US$ 1222/MT), RBD Palmolein (US$ 1225/MT), aur Crude Soya Bean Oil (US$ 1255/MT) jaise items ke rates bhi revise kiye gaye hain.
    *   **Brass Scrap:** Iska tariff value US$ 7639 per metric tonne kar diya gaya hai.
    *   **Areca Nuts:** Tariff value US$ 10785 per metric tonne par fix kiya gaya hai.

Yeh revisions international market trends aur domestic requirements ko reflect karte hain.
